name: rabbitbrush
notes: Rubber rabbitbrush: a rounded bush of many upright felted grey-green stems, each topped with mustard-yellow flower heads in late summer and autumn, in washes and disturbed ground. You walk through it. No leaf tufts (cane_leaves 0): the rabbitbrush leaf material is a herb marker that would grow a whole bush sprite on every tuft voxel. The flower heads are rabbitbrush_flowers marker voxels drawn as small yellow sprays (mesh/sprites.rs).
